principle: Do not create a permanent sub-parameter merely because rubric values can be combined. Create a split candidate only when the distinction changes machine behavior in a source-supported way.

split_score_rubric.formula: transition_difference + threshold_difference + dependency_difference + evidence_difference + identity_difference + controller_difference + result_difference + closure_difference + memory_difference + recurrence + discriminative_value - redundancy - unsupported_complexity
split_score_rubric.rule: The formula is a rubric, not fixed mathematics yet. Do not fabricate weights.

anti_explosion_rules: No Cartesian product generation from rubric dimensions.
No permanent split without source/evidence bindings.
No split merely for linguistic nuance if execution/evidence/closure behavior is unchanged.
Do not mutate the parent native parameter while a candidate split is under review.
A rejected candidate remains archived with reason so the same unsupported split is not repeatedly regenerated.
